items.t: Waymo starts offering rides at the Las Vegas airport
items.d: Waymo only just started offering rides to the public in Las Vegas in September but is already serving a 24-square-mile area in the city.
items.fullText: In Brief Posted: 9:59 AM PDT · October 21, 2026 Image Credits: Waymo Sean O'Kane Waymo starts offering rides at the Las Vegas airport Waymo is now shuttling customers to and from the Harry Reid International Airport in Las Vegas, with pickups and drop-offs happening at dedicated “autonomous vehicle zones” at Terminal 1 and Terminal 3, the company announced Wednesday. This is the sixth major airport that Waymo is serving. The company already offers rides at Phoenix Sky Harbor, Nashville International, San Antonio International, San Francisco International, and San José International airports. Waymo only just started offering rides to the public in Las Vegas in September but is already serving a 24-square-mile area in the city. The company said the rides to and from the Las Vegas airport will be limited at first to just a few riders, before opening up to all customers. Amazon-owned Zoox already offers rides at the Vegas airport, and more robotaxis are coming to Sin City. In August, state regulators approved permits that will allow Tesla and Uber to put thousands of them on the city’s streets in the next year. items.t: Foursquare co-founder says equity holders saw no returns from the company’s acquisition
items.d: Foursquare raised $411 million in funding according to PitchBook data, but its equity holders saw no returns from its final acquisition.
items.fullText: Last month, advertising company Infillion acquired location-data platform Foursquare, a once popular social network, at an undisclosed value. Now, in a new blog post , Foursquare co-founder and former CEO Dennis Crowley said that investors didn’t see any returns from the sale. Crowley referenced a post by an angel investor , inferred that neither preferred nor common stockholders got any value out of the deal, and said he was disappointed by the outcome. “I was heartbroken by this ending. So many people put so much time and energy and passion and love into building Foursquare — the company, the products, the brand, the culture. If you were part of it (or even close to it), you know exactly what I’m talking about. To our ~1600 former employees over 17 years, I am sorry the Foursquare story ended in such a way that makes it seem like our collective efforts were worth … nothing?” he said in the post. Crowley said that the company did well after it started focusing on enterprise business and had consecutive years with over $100 million in revenue. In 2019, the company raised capital from a private equity firm and in 2021 brought in the banker who led the raise as CEO. Crowley blamed the final outcome on that transition, saying that the management of the company wasn’t able to preserve or create new value. Foursquare, which had raised over $411 million in funding according to PitchBook data, eventually shut down its app in 2024 . Several people reacted to Crowley’s post and said that Foursquare was very useful to them in discovering new places in their cities and also gave ideas for new apps . After Foursquare, startups like Zenly and Jagat , along with Instagram and Snapchat , have explored social maps. items.fullText: 경제 한경 PREMIUM9 AI를 넘어서는 성공투자 구독하기 AI 추천 뉴스 AI 추천 뉴스 팝업 닫기 만기일 직접 정하는 정기예금…토스뱅크, 최고 연 3.8% 금리 입력 2026.10.21 17:45 수정 2026.10.22 01:14 지면 A19 기사 스크랩 기사 스크랩 댓글 댓글 기사 공유 공유 글자크기 조절 글자크기 프린트 프린트 장현주 기자 구독하기 구글 검색 선호 출처로 추가 Google 검색에서 한국경제 기사를 더 자주 볼 수 있습니다. 토스뱅크는 21일 최고 연 3.80%의 금리가 적용되는 ‘원하는 날 만기되는 정기예금’을 출시했다. 이 상품은 1개월부터 36개월 사이에서 고객이 원하는 날짜를 직접 골라 만기일로 정하는 예금 상품이다. 금리는 별도 우대 조건 없이 예치 기간에 따라 적용한다. 1년 이상 예치하면 최고 연 3.80%의 금리를 적용받을 수 있다. 3개월 이상 1년 미만으로 예치하면 금리는 연 3.30%다. 원하는 만기일을 정하는 즉시 금리를 확정하는 구조다. 가입 금액은 100만원부터 10억원까지로 1만원 단위로 맡길 수 있다. 만기 전에 돈이 필요하면 ‘미리빼기’ 기능으로 필요한 금액만 먼저 꺼내 쓸 수 있다. 최대 2회까지 이용 가능하다. 100만원 이상의 잔액을 유지하면 남은 금액은 처음 약정한 만기일까지 그대로 예치된다. 미리 뺀 금액에는 중도해지 금리가 적용된다. 만기 후에는 ‘자동 재예치’로 원금과 이자를 같은 기간 동안 다시 맡길 수 있다. 장현주 기자 blacksea@hankyung.com 좋아요 싫어요 후속기사 원해요 ⓒ 한경닷컴, 무단전재 및 재배포 금지 한국경제 구독신청 한경 프리미엄9 구독신청 장현주 기자 한국경제 장현주 기자입니다.
